classique.name: Classic Room
classique.shortDescription: Elegant 22 m² room with a double bed, ideal for a comfortable Parisian stay.
classique.longDescription: A refined room in the heart of Paris, designed for the traveller seeking an authentic experience. Contemporary décor in warm tones, premium bedding, and everything you need for a restful night after a day exploring the capital.

executive.name: Executive Suite
executive.shortDescription: Spacious 38 m² suite with a lounge area and courtyard view, perfect for business travel.
executive.longDescription: Our Executive Suite offers 38 m² of refined comfort. Dedicated workspace, lounge area with sofa, and all the premium services expected for a professional stay or a privileged weekend in Paris.

presidentielle.name: Presidential Suite
presidentielle.shortDescription: Exceptional 75 m² suite with a private terrace and panoramic views over the Parisian rooftops.
presidentielle.longDescription: The ultimate Paris experience. 75 m² of elegance with a private terrace offering breathtaking views of the capital. Walk-in wardrobe, marble bathroom with freestanding bathtub, and personalised services for an exceptional stay.
